description: A powerful file management dashboard for the Umbraco backoffice (Umbraco 17 and 18). Browse, upload, download, edit with Monaco code editor, preview media, rename, delete, extract ZIP, and import files via URL. Includes a Media Cleanup tool that scans for unused, broken, duplicate, orphaned and large media, plus a Recycle Bin view â€” with one-click actions to recycle, restore, permanently delete or empty. Role-based access control and zero configuration.
releaseNotes: v17.6.2 / v18.6.2: Package title cleanup - the NuGet package title no longer carries the "for Umbraco N" suffix, so the marketplace listing shows the plain product name. No functional, API, UI or database changes. v17.6.1 / v18.6.1: Version lines now follow the Umbraco major (17.x for Umbraco 17, 18.x for Umbraco 18) and each line's Umbraco.Cms.Api.Management dependency is boxed to a single major - [17.0.0, 18.0.0) and [18.0.0, 19.0.0) respectively. Previously a single net10.0 build declared [17.0.0, 19.0.0), which let a host pinned to Umbraco 17 be pulled up to Umbraco 18 whenever another package in the project graph demanded 18. Boxing the range per major prevents that cross-major drift: installing into an Umbraco 17 site always resolves the 17.x line and never forces an 18 upgrade. Umbraco 16 (the old net9.0 target) is no longer supported. No functional, API, UI or database changes - this is a packaging/compatibility change only. v4.2.0: New List / Grid view mode in both the File Manager and Media Cleanup (drilled category) views â€” a toolbar toggle switches between the List view (default) and a Grid view of square tiles with image thumbnails (checkerboard background for transparency, like the Umbraco media grid); Media Cleanup grid tiles also show the status tag and row actions. The chosen mode is remembered per browser and thumbnails are lazy-loaded only as tiles scroll into view. The non-admin browse jail now follows the host's configured web root (IWebHostEnvironment.WebRootPath â€” e.g. uTPro:Hosting:RootPath) instead of a hardcoded "wwwroot", so a relocated web root is honoured. Also includes the v4.1.1 fix. v4.1.1: Fixed a Media Cleanup false positive where media served as static files from a custom URL path (e.g. UmbracoMediaPath=~/uploads served from the web root, or a custom UmbracoMediaPhysicalRootPath) were incorrectly reported under "Broken media". The scan now falls back to checking the file physically under the web/content root before flagging it as broken. No breaking API changes. v4.1.0: Security & configurability. The editable-file, protected-name and dangerous-write (RCE) extension lists are now configurable via uTPro:Feature:FileManager â€” EditableExtensions/AdditionalEditableExtensions replace/extend the editable list, while AdditionalBlockedNames and AdditionalDangerousWriteExtensions are additive (built-in protections can never be removed). The protected-name block list is now enforced on view/download too and was expanded (appsettings.production.json, appsettings.staging.json, .env). A new RCE guard blocks creating/saving/renaming server-executable files (.cshtml/.razor/.aspx/.php/.exe...). The media-file and scan-media endpoints now require authorization; SVG files are served as attachments (never inline); import-from-URL re-validates every redirect hop against the DNS-based (IPv6-aware) SSRF guard. Performance: Media Cleanup removes the N+1 tracked-reference queries (batched) and skips hashing files with a unique size. No breaking API changes. v4.0.0: Media Cleanup is now its own workspace tab next to File Manager (no more "Scan Media" toggle). Opening the tab auto-scans and shows overview cards per category (Unused, Broken, Duplicates, Orphaned, Large, Disallowed, Recycle Bin) â€” click a card to drill in; a breadcrumb navigates back; row/bulk actions stay in the footer. Media-backed rows link straight to their node in the Media section (opens in a new tab). No breaking server API changes; hard-refresh the backoffice after upgrading (new workspace manifest). v3.1.1: New "Disallowed" Media Cleanup category â€” physical media files whose extension is in Umbraco's Content:DisallowedUploadedFileExtensions (potential security risk), with recycle/delete actions. Added an ignore list (uTPro:Feature:FileManager:IgnoredMediaIds) to silence false positives in Unused/Large, and scan guardrails (MediaScanMaxFiles, MediaScanTimeBudgetSeconds) that stop very large scans early with an on-screen notice. Upload validation now unions with Umbraco: BlockedUploadExtensions âˆª Content:DisallowedUploadedFileExtensions always reject, and when AllowedUploadExtensions is set it unions with Content:AllowedUploadedFileExtensions (empty = allow all, so site files still upload). No breaking API changes. v3.1.0: Media Cleanup is now actionable. Media-backed rows (Unused/Broken/Duplicates/Large) can be moved to the recycle bin; Orphaned files can be deleted from the media file system; a new Recycle Bin category lets you Restore, Delete permanently, or Empty recycle bin. The scan report is visible to any Settings user, while destructive actions require the current user to have Media section access (Admins always qualify). Also adds bulk actions (row selection), smart duplicate cleanup (keep 1 per hash group), inline media preview, and cached scans (MediaScanCacheSeconds, default 30s) so switching category tabs is fast; a forced reload or any action re-scans. Media lookups resolve by key via IIdKeyMap + GetById(int) for compatibility across Umbraco 16/17/18 (Umbraco 18 removed IMediaService.GetById(Guid)). No breaking API changes. v3.0.0: New Media Cleanup scan â€” from the File Manager footer, "Scan Media" reports Unused media, Broken media, Duplicates, Orphaned files and Large files (client-side paged, filter by category). The large-file threshold is configurable via uTPro:Feature:FileManager:MediaLargeFileThresholdMB (default 100 MB). Scanning uses Umbraco's media file system abstraction so it works with any storage provider. Report-only (no destructive actions). v2.1.0: Configurable upload limits via the uTPro:Feature:FileManager section (MaxUploadSizeMB, AllowedUploadExtensions allow-list, BlockedUploadExtensions block-list) enforced on both file upload and import-from-URL. Import-from-URL now uses IHttpClientFactory and includes an SSRF guard that rejects URLs resolving to loopback/private/link-local/reserved addresses and non-http(s) schemes. No breaking API changes. v2.0.1: Maintenance release â€” clean rebuild from a wiped output to guarantee the shipped assembly is current (packaging now goes through a deterministic clean-pack step). No source or API changes versus 2.0.0. v2.0.0: Support for Umbraco 16, 17 and 18 (multi-target net9.0/net10.0). Hardened path-traversal root check and upload filename sanitization. No breaking API changes.
title: uTPro File Manager & Media Cleanup
